What it is

It is built from parts

Think Lego. A heading, a gallery, a menu, a contact form — each is a separate piece. We use the pieces your business actually needs and leave the rest in the box.

And you keep the box

The pieces are yours. Move them to another host, hand them to another designer, or stay with us — it is the same set of parts either way.

What is included

Reasonable questions

I am not technical. Is that a problem?
No. If we build it, you get one simple screen for changing words, colours and photos — no code, and nothing you can break. If you would rather do it yourself, that is free, and we will point you at the two or three things worth knowing.
Why would I pay monthly if I own the site?
You do not have to. Hosting and management is optional. It covers keeping the site online, updates, and a person to call when something needs changing. Take the files somewhere else and stop paying whenever you like.
How is this different from Wix or Squarespace?
With those, your site lives inside their platform — that is what the monthly fee is renting. Here it is a set of files you hold. It is also why this page appears in a fraction of a second: there is no platform running behind it.
What happens if I want to leave?
You take the files and go. Any host will run them. We would rather earn the $79 a month than hold your website hostage for it.
Will a new website actually get me customers?
Usually not on its own. If you are a local business, most of your visitors come from Google Maps and your Google Business Profile, not from the website. A good site supports that — it repeats your address and hours exactly, and catches the searches Maps cannot serve. If your profile is out of date, fixing that may matter more than the site, and we will tell you so on the call.
